issue_context.title: some  SQL result is not the same when enable/disable plancache
comments:
I think the reason is the expression is computing it's collation using session collation here: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/533de3ba882d188e3e0da4e465f1e74a81b4ccad/expression/collation.go#L242

But when the collation of session changes, the cached plan still uses the old value.

It seems like we should consider connection's charset when hitting the plan cache:
![image](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/assets/7499936/0087a8cf-4795-40e2-ad45-9440efd9be80)

I'll fix it this week.
